svg.title: Aliens: all eight GONK designs and both animation frames
svg.desc: DEF1 / DEF2 contain 32 bytes per design; each frame is assembled as a 2 x 2 tile image.
svg.text: Aliens: all eight GONK designs and both animation frames
DEF1 / DEF2 contain 32 bytes per design; each frame is assembled as a 2 x 2 tile image.
GETDEF -> ALIBUF (64 bytes) -> ALIANI -> $3E88-$3EA7 -> screen codes 209, 210 / 211, 212
Up to four aliens share these glyphs and animate together; PRNALS supplies the cell positions.
